fusions.name: Bitter Vapour
fusions.desc: Breathes a vapour across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 10 poison damage to everything in it and leaves it [Poisoned] for 12 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Drawn in Good Time
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction you have on the target: deals 16 damage and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Bland Diet
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and your allies, and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: What the Dose Leaves
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions lifts, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
